items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 35th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 89 while the rest average 43 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 89/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: A 5.73M-SPX wallet split into 5 fresh wallets
items.detail: 2026-08-10 (15d ago). The pieces inherit the source's coin age, so it's a move, not new buying — often a holder breaking up a position to sit below the radar. Flagged unverified (same-block heuristic) — worth an eyeball.
items.framing: A whale broke a 5.73M SPX position into 5 wallets on 2026-08-10. Interesting because it's the kind of move that normally goes unseen — our clustering caught it. Say "moved/split", never "sold".
items.checkable: Same-block fan-out/fan-in in the raw transfer history; the source wallet is linked below.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-4.8% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 8.03M SPX. 4w -1.4% · 12w -4.8% · 26w -10.5%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-4.8% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: 1 new proven top-timer in 90 days
items.detail: Wallet(s) that just crossed the ROI+capital bar by selling a top at profit — a burst means distribution is starting.
items.framing: 1 wallet(s) newly qualified as smart money in 90d (sold a top at ≥5× ROI). Low count = quiet market; a spike is the tell.
items.checkable: First crossing of the ROI+capital bar per wallet, from the sale history.

items.headline: Price is 0.90× the crowd's cost basis
